name: GetWired Local AI Testing CLI
free_limit: MIT-licensed local CLI for AI-driven exploratory testing of localhost web applications and Android/iOS emulators, with HTML test reports and MCP integration; no vendor-imposed test-run quota documented for the software.
watch_out: Requires a configured AI agent/provider (Claude Code, Auggie, Codex or local OpenCode); external AI subscriptions or API usage may cost money. Web testing targets localhost/loopback only, not public remote URLs. Mobile testing requires emulator/simulator tooling; software does not include hosted compute.
